The '''Home of Cartann's Minister of Trade''' was one of the residences [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] unit [[Red Flight]] was invited to for dinner during their diplomatic visit to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]].<ref name="soa">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>

They dined at a long table on the [[Unidentified Minister of Trade|minister's]] broad balcony, which [[General/Legends|General]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] suspected, was done so that the minister's neighbors might see them and be envious of his guests.<ref name="soa" />
